انعصروا (form VII)
# اِنْعَصَرُوا (inʕaṣarū) /in.ʕa.sˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْعَصَرَ (inʕaṣara)
# اِنْعَصِرُوا (inʕaṣirū) /in.ʕa.sˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْعَصَرَ (inʕaṣara)
